scripts.test: npm run build:harness && tsx --test examples/doom/server/src/*.test.ts examples/doom/bridge/src/*.test.ts packages/executor-microsandbox/src/*.test.ts packages/supervisor-claude/src/*.test.ts packages/supervisor-codex/src/*.test.ts examples/chess/*.test.ts
scripts.build: npm run build:harness && tsx scripts/build-bridge.ts && npm run build:web
scripts.setup: npm run setup:assets && npm run setup:runtime && npm run build
scripts.smoke:session: node --env-file=.env --import tsx scripts/session-smoke.ts create && node --env-file=.env --import tsx scripts/session-smoke.ts reconnect
scripts.evaluate:harness: npm run build:harness && node --env-file=.env --import tsx scripts/evaluation/doom.ts
scripts.smoke:fork-recovery: node --env-file=.env --import tsx scripts/fork-recovery-smoke.ts create && node --env-file=.env --import tsx scripts/fork-recovery-smoke.ts reconnect
scripts.smoke:executor: npm run build:harness && node --import tsx scripts/executor-smoke.ts && node --import tsx scripts/executor-recovery-smoke.ts create && node --import tsx scripts/executor-recovery-smoke.ts recover
scripts.example:chess:web: npm run build:harness && node --env-file-if-exists=.env --import tsx examples/chess/web-server.ts
scripts.example:chess: npm run build:harness && node --env-file-if-exists=.env --import tsx examples/chess/main.ts
scripts.qualify:doom-revisions: npm run build:harness && node --import tsx scripts/qualification/doom-revisions.ts
scripts.build:web: npm run build:web:doom && npm run build:web:chess
scripts.demo:chess: npm run build:harness && npm run build:web:chess && node --env-file-if-exists=.env --import tsx examples/chess/web-server.ts
